meta.name: Dhirwa · Contour
references: Described style, no image reference: a topographic survey map, contour lines closing in on one summit (ذروة, the peak)
The dot of ذ, the first letter of the name, read as the summit point on a map
Kept from Chalkboard/Aurora: layout, spacing, radii, motion timing, the two 3D hero mechanics (home intro, student-home ride)
meta.audience: Arabic-speaking secondary students (grades 10-12) across the GCC and Egypt, the parents who pay, and the teachers who sell
meta.notes: Colours are chosen, not measured (no reference image), so there is no measured_palette and no verify step. Contrast ratios are WCAG 2.x and listed in DESIGN.md §0.

surface.usage: Warm survey-paper for every page; white cards on it

primary.name: trail green
primary.usage: Actions, links, focus ring. White on it 5.8:1

secondary.name: night map
secondary.usage: The map stage: home hero, closing band, student-home hero

accent.name: summit gold
accent.usage: The summit point, the one highlighted word per heading (contour underline), the stage's primary button, what a student earned. Never text on paper; night on it 8.9:1

contour.usage: Elevation ramp, low to high (1-4), the trail line (5), snow line (6). Contour lines on the map, the footer rule, the ride's track. Never body text on paper

neutral.usage: Lightest to darkest. #13202F is ink on paper; #EEF0EA is text on the map, #9FAABB muted text on the map

countries.usage: Unchanged: one trail colour per country

families.mark: Reem Kufi 700: the Arabic wordmark ذروة and words set on the map only. Geometric Kufi, drawn like survey lettering. Never body text, never in app pages
families.data: IBM Plex Sans Arabic, tabular numerals

typography.letter_spacing: Latin wordmark +0.04em; uppercase labels +0.06em; Arabic never letter-spaced

shape.dividers: a contour line: thin, slightly wavy, in the elevation ramp

iconography.mark: Three nested contour rings forming a peak, a summit-gold dot on top (the dot of ذ). 64×48 grid

motion.reduced_motion: All durations 0; 3D scenes render their final frame once

components.button: Pill, 44px high, trail green on paper; on the map the primary button is summit gold with night text (.btn-glow)
components.card: White, 24px radius, hairline, paper shadow; lifts 3px on hover
components.heading_accent: .marker: one word per heading underlined by a hand-drawn contour line in summit gold; on the map the word itself turns gold
components.footer: Closes on a thin band of stacked contour lines in the elevation ramp

design_style.aesthetic: Survey map meets exercise book: precise, quiet, ambitious
design_style.visual_language: Nested contour lines, elevation as progress, one summit point. Lines are the only ornament
design_style.composition: Paper pages with generous whitespace; one dark map stage per marketing page at most; content in clear columns, never over the map's lines
design_style.imagery: No stock photos. The map, the subject icons, country flags and real course covers only
design_style.interaction_feel: Rise, then rest: things rise from flat to their place at a calm pace, then stay still
design_style.brand_voice_in_ui: Encouraging, exact, never hype. 'Your next step' over 'Unlock your potential'

overview.effect_intensity: medium on the home hero, none in app pages
overview.performance_tier: mid: one WebGL canvas per page, DPR capped at 2, paused off-screen

background_effects.description: .stage: night map gradient, a faint static contour pattern (SVG) and fine paper grain; all still

3d_elements.home_intro: Summit, minimal (src/components/three/summit-scene.ts). Eight thin snow contour lines (six on a phone), fainter low and clearer high, only the top one summit gold. 0-0.8s the lines fade in flat like a map; 0.6-2.6s they lift into the peak while the camera tilts to three-quarter view; 1.8-3.4s a fine gold trail climbs the face in one gentle curve; 3.3-3.8s one gold point settles on the summit. No flag, no colour ramp. Fits itself into the free space beside the hero copy on any screen. Copy rises at 3.2s; SUMMIT_END 4.0s. Then a slow drift and pointer parallax; any input jumps to the end; once per tab session.
3d_elements.student_home: The ride keeps its mechanics; its track becomes a trail with waypoints, coloured with the contour ramp and the country line

scroll_effects.description: CSS animation-timeline: view() reveals, 16px rise + fade, marketing pages only

cursor_effects.description: Pointer parallax on the hero scene only, at most 3 degrees

svg_animations.description: The contour underline draws once on reveal (stroke-dashoffset, 700ms)

visual_effects.composite_notes: The word ذروة / Dhirwa is DOM text over the canvas, never drawn into it, so it stays translatable and selectable. Diagrams are never mirrored; only the column order swaps in RTL.
